26: A famous 2-star ancient ruins hunter and the father of Gon Freeccs. When Ging was a child, he left his home on Whale Island to become a hunter and did not return home for 10 years, carrying a young Gon whom he entrusted to Mito.
27: Killua is a member of the Zoldyck family, who are all legendary assassins. Since birth, he trained endlessly in the art of assassination. He eventually ran away from his family and profession to participate in the Hunter exam.
28: Kurapika is a member of the Kurta tribe who were massacred by the Phantom Troupe (The Spiders) 4 years prior the Hunter exam. The Kurta tribe was an isolated group of people whose eyes would turn scarlet when angered or excited.
29: Prior to the hunter exam, Leorio's close friend died to a curable illness, and Leorio was unable to save him due to his lack of money and knowledge. Because of this. he aims to become a doctor in order to help those without the money to pay for treatment.
30: Gon is the son of Ging Freecss, a legendary hunter whose current whereabouts are unknown. He never knew his father was alive, much less a hunter until he met Kite; a hunter who was also looking for Ging.
31: Notorious for his cruel and deceitful fighting ability, Hisoka has proven to be deadly. His deviousness and volatility have caused many opponents to have difficulty anticipating his next move, and this has led to him winning many battles.
57: Illumi is Killua's eldest brother. He is an experienced assassin, whom along with his father was responsible for Killua's training and upbringing.
58: Chrollo Lucilfer is a calm, young man, coming across as intelligent and charismatic. He seems to be a born leader, able to hold the Genei Ryodan (Phantom Troupe) together despite the volatile personalities that make up the group. He is also an incredibly skilled fighter.
59: Zeno Zoldyck is Killua's grandfather and Silva's father. A witty old man, his advancing age has not dampened his quick thinking and speed in battle. Zeno wears alternating signs on his garb that say either "A Kill A Day" or "Never Retire.
60: Silva is Killua's father. He is a silent, pensive figure, and Killua seems to rarely interact with him, although Killua does look up to him.
3195: A mysterious member of the Phantom Troupe, Feitan is attired in what one would expect from a bandit - dark clothes with a skullhead scarf that covers his mouth. Feitan seldom speaks, but when he does, there's usually a word missing.
5828: A hulking, Frankensteinian monster is what Franklin (Furankurin) appears to be, complete with scars and sewn-up wounds that ravage his face.
5829: As one of the members of the Phantom Troupe, the most distinctive thing about Kortopi is his haggard appearance. A thick and messy mane of hair flops down his face, obscuring everything except for an occasional glimpse of his eyeball.
5830: Not known to show much emotion, Machi seems to be one of the coldest members of the Phantom Troupe. The only person she has shown some feeling towards was Chrollo.
5831: Like one of the ronin warriors in Edo period Japan, Nobunaga comes complete with a long Japanese sword that he uses with great finesse and skill. Nobunaga's speciality is the unparalleled use of the sword in executing enemies.
5832: From his appearance, Shalnark seems to be a guileless and normal boy. However, see him in action with the rest of the Phantom Troupe and that thought is dispelled.
5833: Shizuku is member number 8 of the Phantom Troupe. She has been described as being a natural airhead, seeing as how some of her actions do not point towards her being very bright. Shizuku is quite forgetful; once she forgets something, she won't remember it.
5834: Phinks is a genius when it comes to unarmed combat. Phinks uses his hands in battle, which have been shown to be extremely powerful. He is rather brash and has a tendency to get into conflicts with other people.
5835: Pakunoda exudes an air of self-confidence that can be intimidating to others. She is fully loyal to Chrollo. She is one of the original Phantom Troupe from Meteor City. Her physical strength is 11th in the Troupe.
5836: Uvogin is the eleventh member of the Phantom Troupe. Nobunaga has compared his personality to Gon's, seeing how not only do they have the same Nen type, but their behavior is similar as well, being impulsive and short tempered.
6088: One of the two examiners that presided over the second stage of the Exam. Her exam topic was to prepare a piece of sushi for her to taste. If it met up to her stringent expectations, the candidate would pass.
6089: Kalluto Zoldyck is the younger brother of Killua. He was initially introduced accompanying his mother during Gon's retrieval of Killua from his home on Kukuroo Mountain.
10535: Leroute is a criminal who manipulates her victims. She is smart, sharp, and insightful. Leroute was formerly a deranged psychologist who reveled in the misery of her clients. She often attacked her victims psychologically to such a degree that they often committed suicide.
12515: Senritsu, known as Melody in the Viz Media translation, is a Music Hunter, named for her skill with instruments. Senritsu is a Music Hunter and is the kind and understanding member of Neon's bodyguards.
14489: None other than the Chairman of the Hunter Committee, and the final authority over the entirety of the Hunter Exam.
17564: Neon is the daughter of the boss of the Nostrade family, who are part of the Mafia. She is a hyper but spoiled young girl, who enjoys collecting body parts (whether they are legal or not) as her hobby. She is constantly protected by many bodyguards by the order of her father.
17720: He's one of the three fighters that challenge Gon and Killua on the 200th floor of Heavens Arena. Having reached the 200th floor without the use of Nen, he was "initiated" after being attacked with a malicious aura attack and paralyzed from the waist down.
18108: The head of the Nostrade Mafia Family and Kurapika's temporary employer. Light usually has a calm personality but goes on edge when it's about the safety of his daughter Neon. He is very indulging on his daughter's whims.
20594: Kite is the very first Hunter introduced in the story. He is a disciple of Ging Freecss, Gon's father. After saving Gon from a foxbear on Whale Island, Kite revealed to him the truth about his father. Before he took his leave, Kite left Ging's Hunter License in Gon's hands.
20677: An 18-year-old jounin ninja from the Cloud Hidden Village whom has trained in the art of ninjutsu from the moment he could stand. He decided to become a Hunter in order to find the elusive Hermit's Scroll.
20678: Mito Freecss is Gon's adopted mother, and cousin to Ging Freecss. In the manga, Mito did not want Gon to become a Hunter because Ging only came back home once after he took the Hunter's exam. She did not want Gon to leave his family like Ging did.
22519: A seemingly mouthless man, the appointed examiner for the first part of the Hunter Exam. He tests the examinees' stamina by leading them on an marathon of initially unknown length through an underground tunnel.
22521: Wing is a Nen trainer whose main student is Zushi. He meets Gon and Killua at the Celestial Tower.
22522: Examinee #16 during the Hunter exam. Tonpa is nicknamed the "Rookie Crusher" by other candidates with more experience taking the exam.
24279: Examinee #246 during the Hunter Exam. Ponzu is the only prominent female who managed to enter the last few stages of the Hunter exam.
33375: The second oldest of the five Zaoldyeck brothers, he is obese and a big-time otaku. He himself states that he does in fact assassinate people, so it can be assumed that he is also trained in fighting and is stronger than the average human.
33376: In the same Hunter exam as Gon, Pokkle ends up passing. He pursues his dream of becoming a Wildlife Hunter, discovering new types of animals and plants. In the Hunter exam Pokkle uses a bow and arrows tipped with a paralyzing poison.
33378: One of the bodyguards hired to protect Neon. She is from the Manipulation group. Her hatsu, Instant Love, makes every man she kisses her slave. Her slaves enjoy being hurt by her, which she videotapes. She uses this to make men tell the truth.
33379: Squala is one of Neon Nostrade's bodyguards. During the job interview for new hires, he was one of the two moles planted alongside the applicants in order to test their strength. Although Squala has been one of Neon's bodyguards for many years, he does not have a Hunters License.
33380: Basho is one of Neon Nostrade's new bodyguards, hired along with Kurapika. When he was first introduced he was quick to underestimate Kurapika, but after Kurapika's display of his 'Dowsing Chain', he grew respect for him.
33381: Sachmono is one of Neon's bodyguard. He is one of the two spies in Kurapika's test. Sachmono is a professional hunter. He is from the Emission group. His hatsu is the ability to summon 11 assassin's made out of nen.
33382: Dalzollene is a leader of Neon Nostrade's bodyguards and Kurapika's direct superior. His weapon is a katana inscribed with runes that increase its power when infused Nen. In the anime, he manages to pierce Uvogin by 5 millimeters with the katana.
35894: A servant to the Zoldyck family. She believes their difference in status means they will never be close. Unbeknownst to her, Killua regards her as a dear friend.
38620: Siper was a participant in the 287th Hunter Exam and one of its few female contestants. She was examinee #80
38622: Anita is the daughter of a wealthy spice merchant who was assassinated by one of the Zaoldyecks. she takes the Hunter Exam because she knows that Killua is there and she wants to kill him to avenge her father.
43931: A young boy who studies Shingen-Ryu Kung fu and Nen under the tutelage of Wing, whom Gon and Killua meet in the Heavens Arena. He is a formidable fighter and a prodigy in his own right, said to have skills only 1 out of 100,000 people have.
50847: One of the second stage examiners during the Hunter exam, along with Menchi. Buhara is an Epicurean Hunter, and is a hulking figure with a large potbelly and an even larger appetite. Buhara's easy-going nature contrasts with Menchi's highly selective one.
53271: Beans (Maamen in the Nippon Animation adaptation) is Netero's personal secretary and helps to organize a lot of things during Hunter Exam.
53275: Johness is a sadistic and psychotic individual, nothing gave him greater pleasure than the feel of bleeding flesh in his hands and hearing the screams of agony from his victims.
53559: Togari is a former Hunter examiner, who returns at the 287th hunter exam. He appears during the third phase of the exam where he confronts Hisoka, not as examiner but to take revenge for Hisoka giving him the two scars on his face from the previous exam.
53561: Todo is a wrestler and aspires to become a blacklist hunter. He is the 255th participant in the 287th Hunter Exam. As stated by Tonpa before the start of 1st stage of the Hunter Exam, Todo is a lot smarter than he looks.
55949: Examinee #118 during the Hunter Exam. With a trained monkey that follows him wherever he goes. Somi teamed up with Tonpa to steal Leorio's number tag at during the fourth exam.
57757: Examinee #191 during the Hunter exam. An expert at martial arts, Bodoro is a strict and seemingly stubborn old man with an unspoken rivalry with another martial artist participating in the Hunter Exam.
58907: Zebro is one of two groundskeepers at the Zoldyck family's estate on Kukuroo Mountain. He acts as a gatekeeper in front of the Testing Gate at first glance, but is actually just a janitor that cleans up after Mike (the largest Zoldyck guard dog) after it disposes off intruders.
59457: Killua's mother, who was injured while attempting to prevent him from running away from home (although Illumi states that she is proud of Killua for doing so). She dresses in Victorian style clothing and has a visor covering her eyes.
60009: The Zoldyck family manager. All contacts with the family members must go through him. An enigmatic and intimidating character, Killua once expressed to Gon his recurring nightmares of Gotou chasing him with a knife. He is also superb at the "where is the coin" trick.
61953: Seaquant is a Blacklist Hunter and a servant of the Zoldyck Family.
61955: Kiriko are Magical Beasts that can change their own physical appearance.
63099: He is a prominent fighter in the Heavens Arena and an apparent celebrity. Lives on the 200th floor as a fighter, uses martial arts and is very skillful in hand-to-hand combat. He had accumulated enough wins to become a Floor Master.
63539: Umori is the sturdiest of the Amori Brothers and examinee #199 in the 287th Hunter Exam. He does not have eyebrows and dresses in a collarless baseball jersey and a backward baseball cap.
63541: Amori is the oldest of the Amori Brothers and examinee #197 in the 287th Hunter Exam. He always wears a tuque and a polo neck sweater.
64137: He is one of the three Heavens Arena fighters who wanted to challenge Gon and Killua for easy wins. He appears to be mean and will do everything in order to become a Floor Master.
64513: He is one of the three fighters that challenge Gon and Killua on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena. Having reached the 200th floor without being able to use Nen, Gido was "initiated" after being attacked with a malicious aura attack and lost both of his legs.
66135: The live announcer at the arena.
67203: One of Neon Nostrade's personal attendants. She is always seen wearing a kimono and following Neon.
70621: Zepile is an antiques trader who helps Gon raise funds for the Southernpiece Auction in Yorknew City.
237341: A confident rock climber who got attacked and captured by monster birds while trying to descend trick tower along the outer wall during Hunter Exam's third phase.
